title: This merge proposal introduces a patch for fwupdmgr related to TPM/FDE recovery key readiness. More specifically, it prompts the user for their recovery key on updates affecting FDE and makes a POST call to the snapd endpoint /v2/system-volumes action "check-recovery-key", continuing the update if successful.
description:
This merge proposal introduces a patch for fwupdmgr related to TPM/FDE recovery key readiness. More specifically, it prompts the user for their recovery key on updates affecting FDE and makes a POST call to the snapd endpoint /v2/system-volumes action "check-recovery-key", continuing the update if successful.

PPA: https://launchpad.net/~bamf0/+archive/ubuntu/fwupd-lp2138609-fwupdmgr-prompt-snapd

Per file changes include:

* src/fu-console.{c,h}:
  - Add recovery key input prompt disabling echo and canonical mode.
  - Add explicit_bzero alternative function for compatibility.
* src/fu-util-common.c:
  - Extend fu_util_prompt_warning_fde to also prompt for snapd recovery key.
  - Add CURL POST call to snapd UNIX domain socket for checking recovery key.
  - Add global state variable for caching checks between updates within the same process.
* debian/rules: Regenerate fwupd.pot on builds.
